hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SuperDCA token pools that enforces a three-tier dynamic fee structure (0% internal, 0.10% keeper, 0.50% external) based on swapper identity, restricts swaps to admin-allowlisted routers, and distributes minted SuperDCA rewards 50/50 between LPs (via pool donation) and a developer address during liquidity and swap operations.
